newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: SBI index soars as foreigners return en masse.
newsitem.headline: SBI index soars as foreigners return en masse.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index surged 6.19 percent on Tuesday as foreign investors returned en masse, encouraged by the Bank of Slovenia's relaxation of investment rules.
"I see no reason for the index not to reach 1,500 points by the end of the week," said Davor Dubokovic, a trader at Eastbrokers.

The central bank said last week expensive balancing of money paid into fiduciary acounts, which international portfolio investors must hold in order to trade in securities, would not be necessary when shares are held for at least seven years.
* The blue-chip SBI index surged 78.16 points to 1,340.59.
* Petrol trader Petrol was the most active, up 7.84 percent to 18,980 tolars on volume of 1,836 shares.
* Health resort Terme Catez was the biggest gainer, up 9.9 percent to 12,650 tolars on volume of 1,585 shares. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
